capabilities: Draw and arrange task cards on an infinite canvas
Plan tasks in Day and Calendar views with routines and drag-rescheduling
Track task status in Kanban and List views
Sketch freehand ink strokes on the board
Merge concurrent board edits from other devices with conflict review
extras: README urges installing in a test vault and backing up before upgrading; collaboration is not real-time (no presence or server), and attachments, recurring tasks, and .canvas export are explicitly out of scope.
problem: Obsidian has no single planning surface that combines a spatial task canvas with kanban, daily scheduling, and note previews stored as plain Markdown.

relations.evidence: When another device (through Self-hosted LiveSync or any file sync) or an agent changes a board

summary: Visual task board with canvas, Kanban, List, Day and Calendar views over the same tasks, plus freehand ink and record-level merging over vault sync.
